summary: Reproduced the independent review against candidate e10d8adc527259f9bfd2a489675120226794f3fc. A dense BF16 MTP layer matched by a broad Linear W4A8 compressed-tensors target still raises during construction without an MTP ignore entry. Preserved the candidate's actionable error context and packed-layer safety boundary, and added the missing user documentation. No automatic dense fallback was added because checkpoint tensor names are unavailable when parameter storage is selected, so a prefix-only fallback could silently allocate incompatible dense storage for genuinely packed MTP weights.

remaining_limitations: Dense MTP weights still require an explicit quantization_config.ignore entry; this PR improves diagnosis and documents the safe configuration but does not claim to resolve no-ignore startup.
Actual packed MTP checkpoint loading was not exercised. The regression only proves that pre-load selection does not silently choose UnquantizedLinearMethod.
No full Qwen3-Next checkpoint or original 2x H100 NVL TP2/EP2 environment was available, so end-to-end server startup remains unverified.
